summary: The revised manuscript and archived artifacts address the prior closure-review required clarifications about shared_initial_candidate semantics, the mapping from the preregistered three-arm design to the executed paired contrast, and the preregistered power invalidation; execution and analysis artifacts substantiate the reported results. No remaining critical issues were identified for closure review.
optional_revisions: Condense the in-paper Disclosure Statement to a shorter paragraph that still preserves all mandatory facts and points readers to the archived provenance bundle for detailed logs and hashes.
Add a one-line boxed mapping (or small table) in Methods showing preregistration labels A/B/C → executed contrast under shared_initial_candidate semantics to aid readers unfamiliar with the term.

Optionally note in one short sentence that the single discordant pair corresponds to pair-000069 (terminal_factual_accounting) and that its validator traces are archived, to facilitate targeted audit without embedding low-level paths or hashes in the manuscript body.
